requested: execute one global simplified formal test after the checkpoint-contract repair
preserved: production MuJoCo env, replay, optimizer, checkpoint gateway and strict reader
forbidden: reimplemented loss, replay, persistence, or lineage validator
collector/CUDA claims from a CPU pseudo-transaction

source_edits.scope: local test/evidence code only; no production behavior added for the rig

report_write.scope: local formal test and evidence receipts

repository_discipline.rationale: The rig imports the unchanged production composition root and owners; it adds no runtime selector, backend feature, or script-layer business rule.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The rig orchestrates; Hydra, env, replay, learner, runner and gateway retain their production decisions.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Only build_runner, ReplayBuffer, learner update methods, runner checkpoint dispatch and strict load_state_dict are invoked.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Test code depends on production; production has no dependency on the test rig.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Temporary replay/checkpoints are bounded and cleaned; mutation and restoration are explicitly observed.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: One test file and evidence receipt cover the global path without modifying production for test selection.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: CPU offline composition is separated from collector/CUDA, training convergence and policy quality.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: The rig has identity, replay/update effect, full-state persistence, strict restoration and exact-lineage witnesses with explicit falsifiers.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Asymmetric 98D actor and 303D critic transitions pass through the production replay layout and learner.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The production Critic and Actor optimizer methods run once and the Actor parameter delta is observed.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: A full state round-trip and the same gateway's exact 20+1 finalizer are both inside the bounded campaign.

residual_risks.description: The offline rig does not execute collector subprocess synchronization or CUDA compilation/transfer.
residual_risks.disposition: Formal audit may retain at most one bounded LIVE_REQUIRED fact; do not infer it from offline PASS.
